html: The evidence tools now say plainly what they could not do, and the alarms reach a person. The harvester prints its progress channel by channel and works to a time budget inside GitHub's limit, recording what it did not reach instead of being cancelled with nothing. The licence watcher lists six pages that refuse automated requests as needing a person, never as unchanged, instead of reporting a partial run every week. The retraction watcher names two DataCite DOIs as not checkable at Crossref instead of counting them as failures. The tripwire's issue is assigned to the steward, names the one action and says when a month can no longer be recovered. No dataset, grade, licence class or schema changed.
